post.description:
Without general Harness overrides, stream agent events over SSE. `streaming` defaults to false; set it to true for incremental model output. Create a session under harness_agent first. MCP-only overrides preserve the normal streaming behavior

KeyAuth deployments support general `harness` overrides. This path waits for completion and returns a single SSE event; `streaming` does not enable incremental output. General overrides read only text from `new_message.parts`; `state_delta` and `invocation_id` are not applied on that path

Shared OAuth deployments support MCP-only overrides, not general model, tool, or instruction overrides. Failures can appear inside the SSE stream as `data: {"error":"..."}`, so HTTP 200 does not establish invocation success. Use `curl -N` for live output

post.description:
Available only on KeyAuth deployments; waits for completion and returns JSON. Shared OAuth deployments do not expose this endpoint. Overrides apply only to this request, with omitted fields inherited from deployment; `harness_merge` and `harness_enhance` are not supported

`tools` and `skills` append to existing configuration. `mcp_servers` replaces the full list, and an empty list clears MCP for this request. Execution failures can still return HTTP 200; inspect `error`, which is null on success. MCP-only overrides may leave `overwrite` false

200.description: Invocation result; inspect the error field

post.description:
Return results over SSE. Use prompt from a JSON object when present; other JSON values are converted to text, while non-JSON bodies are treated as raw text. User and session IDs come from request headers, defaulting to agentkit_user and an empty string; explicitly provide both

The endpoint checks and creates the session automatically. The application is selected from the loaded agent, so no application name is needed in the body. It supports per-request `harness.mcp_servers` overrides but does not apply other Harness overrides. Errors after streaming starts are returned as error events

  --data '{"name": "daily-report", "prompt": "Summarize recent activity", "schedule": {"cron": "0 9 * * *", "timezone": "Asia/Shanghai"}, "idempotency_key": "daily-report-v1"}'

import json
import os
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen

base_url = os.environ["HARNESS_URL"]
headers = {"Authorization": "Bearer " + os.environ["HARNESS_TOKEN"]}

headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
data = json.dumps({'name': 'daily-report', 'prompt': 'Summarize recent activity', 'schedule': {'cron': '0 9 * * *', 'timezone': 'Asia/Shanghai'}, 'idempotency_key': 'daily-report-v1'}).encode()
request = Request(base_url + f"/harness/cronjobs", headers=headers, method="POST", data=data)
with urlopen(request) as response:
    print(json.load(response))
